intro: The client records pack, for clinics, therapists, vets, opticians and salons that keep a record of each client. Switch it on in Settings › Industry packs. The front desk sees names, phones, visits and consent only; clinical notes open to the care team, and every look is logged.
start: Switch the client records pack on in Settings › Industry packs.
Check the wording of each consent on Consent and privacy, and how long each lasts.
Register your first client on Clients, and record their consent to treatment.
Add the practitioners who treat them to the client's care team.

articles.title: Register a client and record their consent
articles.summary: Add the client with their contact details, then record what they agree to. A child needs a guardian, and their consent is the guardian's.

steps.lead: Enter their full name, phone, email and date of birth.
steps.rest: For a minor, add the guardian's name and phone.
They get a client number, and the list shows whether treatment consent is in place.

steps.lead: Open the client and press Record consent
steps.rest: for each purpose they agree to, say who signed, and press Save consent.
for each practitioner who treats them.

tips: Without valid consent, what needs it is blocked, such as a photo or sharing with an insurer.
Press Withdraw on a consent when the client takes it back, and give the reason.

articles.title: Open a record and write a note
articles.summary: Open the clinical record, write and sign notes, record measurements and add documents. Each time it is opened is logged.

steps.lead: Choose Open record… from the client's Actions.
steps.rest: The care team opens it at once; anyone else writes why they need it.

steps.lead: Under Notes, press Write a note,
steps.rest: choose the kind and write it.
to come back to it, or sign it to make it final.
and attach documents and photos as you need them.
when you step away. The record also locks by itself after a few idle minutes.

tips: A signed note never changes. Press Correct to add a correction that names the first note.
In an emergency, someone outside the care team can break the glass with a written reason. The privacy officer is told at once.
To print or share a record, use Print or share this record, say who it is for and why, and press Export. That is logged too.

articles.title: Answer a request for a copy, correction or deletion
articles.summary: Record what the client asked for and decide it within 30 days. Overdue requests are marked.

steps.lead: Choose the client and what is asked:
steps.rest: a copy of the record, a correction or deletion. Add the details and press Record.
when it is done or refused, say what was done or why it was refused, and press Save decision.

tips: Nothing is ever deleted by hand. A deletion decided as done erases the clinical content and keeps the client as an erased client with their number.
Records whose retention has run out are listed here, for the privacy officer to review and erase.
